name: Sawyer, Michigan (Harbor Country)
note: Street lines are hand-placed from town centres and need a check on the ground; Sawyer itself is unincorporated (Chikaming Township) and has no Census place line.

corridors.name: Red Arrow Highway
corridors.why: The old shore road the Harbor Country towns string along; Sawyer's market, butcher and antique mall sit on it.

corridors.name: Sawyer Road
corridors.why: Downtown Sawyer to I-94 exit 12, the door from Chicago; the brewery and garden centre are here.

corridors.name: Three Oaks Road
corridors.why: Ties Sawyer to Three Oaks, the next town inland.
